args.body: Hi Dora! I visited your website (www.dora-website.com) and it's a great start. It's simple and clear!
Hi Eve! I checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I love that you share your passion for hiking! Keep it up.

final_text:
I have visited both websites and sent the feedback:

1.  **Dora**: I invited her to Slack using the email found on her site (`dora@gmail.com`) and sent her a message complimenting the simplicity and clarity of her website.
2.  **Eve**: I sent her a message praising her blog and her passion for hiking.
